metadata.purpose: Normative case-to-test ledger with scoped implementation evidence; endpoint and independent-peer gates remain distinct.
metadata.ownership: Coordinator owns resource choices, profile values and overall matrix; this ledger references six existing profiles only.
metadata.evidence_boundary: P02/P03 offline checks and fixtures do not pass behavior rows. P05/P06 now record linked primary codec/framing checks. Overall rows remain partial until all listed primary/peer/interop gates pass.
metadata.scope: Six host-simulation instances: DIRECT-1, RADIO-1 SELECTIVE-32 and distinct TEST-RADIO-RETRY-ALL, each NNpsk0/XX, cipher 1, two endpoints and services 1 SAMPLE-1/2 plus 2 OPAQUE-1/1. Service-1 freshness is off; service-2 freshness is off for DIRECT and uses actual S7 grants for both radio identities. Both radio paths model two static relays. Full logical max 1024 bytes; DIRECT max 16 fragments/chunk 64, radio max 32/chunk 32. Simulation is not physical evidence.
metadata.source_hash_scope: Original checkout byte snapshot at P03 acceptance; newline conversion of documentary sources is not a PROFILE_HASH change. Manifest hashes always identify exact bytes.
metadata.result_fields: status is whole-row status; primary_result is scoped to primary_gate; primary_checks names actual linked tests/functions; peer_result and interop_result remain not-run. primary_remaining records unexecuted compound obligations.
